crew.overview: One part vigilante, one part criminal kingpin, Red Hood begins cleaning up Gotham with the efficiency of Batman, but without following the same ethical code.
crew.title: Batman: Under the Red Hood

crew.overview: On the mystical island of Themyscira, a proud and fierce warrior race of Amazons have raised a daughter of untold beauty, grace and strength: Princess Diana. When an Army fighter pilot, Steve Trevor, crash-lands on the island, the rebellious and headstrong Diana defies Amazonian law by accompanying Trevor back to civilization.
crew.title: Wonder Woman

crew.overview: When the Hulk's presence on Earth becomes too great a risk, the Illuminati trick him to board a shuttle destined for a planet where he will be able to live in peace, and launch it into space. The Hulk's struggle to escape causes the shuttle to malfunction and crash land on the planet Sakaar, however, where he is sold into slavery and trained as a gladiator.
crew.title: Planet Hulk

details.biography:
Brandon Vietti is an American producer, director, and story artist.  Vietti’s directing credits include Batman: Under the Red Hood, Batman: The Brave and the Bold, Legion of Superheroes, Superman Doomsday, The Batman, Spider-man: The Animated Series, and Jackie Chan Adventures. 

Vietti’s storyboard credits include Justice League: Crisis On Two Earths, Green Lantern: First Flight, Wonder Woman, Thor: Tales of Asgard, Planet Hulk, The Invincible Iron Man, and Roughnecks: The Starship Troopers Chronicles. Vietti is currently producing the Young Justice series for Warner Brothers Animation.
details.name: Brandon Vietti
